_comment: Paths in 'dest' are relative to MODELS_DIR (see .env).  Two kinds:
file     - one file from a HF repo, saved at dest
snapshot - a whole HF repo (or a subtree of it) mirrored under dest
'3d_checkpoints/...' is what the container mounts over ComfyUI-3D-Pack's
own Checkpoints folder, so those paths must match what the nodes expect:
groups: 'core' is fetched by default.  Everything else is opt-in with
--group NAME, or --all for all but 'gated' and 'noncommercial'.  'gated' needs HF_TOKEN.
Every entry carries 'license', 'license_url' and 'commercial'. `fetch_models.py --licenses` prints them, and --download refuses a non-commercial model unless you pass --accept-noncommercial.

groups.core: SDXL base and its fp16-fix VAE, plus the TripoSR and TripoSG weights, ~20GB. Their image-to-3D graphs do not work as wired yet: see the _comment in img2mesh_triposr.json and img2mesh_triposg.json
groups.hunyuan: Hunyuan3D 2.1 shape and PBR texture generation, plus the 2.0 turbo shape model (best mesh quality, ~24GB)
groups.mvadapter: MV-Adapter multiview / texturing on top of SDXL, ~17GB
groups.unique3d: Unique3D + CharacterGen chain (SD1.5, IP-Adapter, ControlNet tile, RealESRGAN), ~23GB
groups.gated: StableFast3D, ~4GB. Accept the licence on HF and set HF_TOKEN
groups.noncommercial: Models whose licence forbids commercial use, ~0.5GB. Never fetched by --all
groups.qwen: Qwen-Image text-to-image, ~48GB. Apache-2.0, far better prompt adherence than SDXL base. The concept presets need it
groups.qwen_edit: Qwen-Image-Edit 2509, ~19GB. Change one element of a concept without rerolling it
groups.qwen_rapid: Phr00t's Qwen-Image-Edit Rapid AIO for complete_workflow.json: the v19 SFW checkpoint with its text encoder and VAE merged in (~26GB), the v18 SFW Q4_K GGUF (~12GB), which reuses the qwen group's text encoder and VAE, and the Anything2Real LoRA, which is fetched only with --accept-noncommercial. Licences unsettled: see --licenses
groups.wan_i2v: WAN 2.2 image-to-video 14B for complete_workflow.json's video group: the high- and low-noise fp8 experts, the umT5 text encoder, the 2.1 VAE and the lightx2v 4-step LoRAs, ~35GB. Apache-2.0
groups.krea2: Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image for txt2img_krea2.json, txt2img_krea2_style.json and krea_workflow.json: the int8 ConvRot weights, the Qwen3-VL 4B text encoder, ostris's style reference LoRA and the Qwen VAE, ~18GB. Krea 2 Community License: commercial use, outputs included, only while company revenue is under $1M a year, and Krea may end it on 30 days' notice: see --licenses. krea_workflow.json's Edit and Animate stages also need qwen_edit, the qwen group's text encoder and wan_i2v
groups.music: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo text-to-music, ~10GB. MIT, and its model card allows commercial use of the music it makes

models.name: RMBG-1.4 (background removal for image-to-3D)
models.note: Not required. Hunyuan3D and TRELLIS remove backgrounds themselves with rembg (MIT) and its u2net model (Apache-2.0); TripoSG does not remove backgrounds.  Only fetch this if you have a BRIA commercial agreement, or the project is non-commercial.

models.name: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (TRELLIS image encoder)
models.note: NOTHING READS THIS PATH. Verified by holding the four HF-layout files out and re-running TRELLIS: identical result, 29s, 48000 faces. Neither TRELLIS branch wants them - the plain branch pulls dinov2_vitl14_reg through torch.hub into its own cache, Stable3DGen wants the .pth entry below. StableFast3D DOES use facebook/dinov2-large, but as a hub id resolved through HF_HOME, so this copy does not satisfy it either. A candidate for removal.

models.name: TRELLIS normal v0.1 (Stable3DGen weights)
models.note: The four ckpts/*.safetensors that Load StableGen Trellis Pipeline requires. Their matching .json configs already ship with the node pack; only the weights were missing.

models.note: Stable3DGen builds this exact path and filename, and downloads it at run time if absent. The upstream file is named dinov2_vitl14_reg4_pretrain.pth; the dest renames it to what the loader looks for.

models.name: MV-Adapter
models.note: SDXL adapters only; the sd21 and beta/partial variants are not used by the shipped workflows

models.name: SDXL base 1.0 (diffusers format, for MV-Adapter)
models.note: fp16 variants only; the fp32/onnx/openvino copies in that repo are another 25GB of the same weights

models.name: ImageDream (multiview for LGM)
models.license: OpenRAIL (per the Hub cards; no licence text found)
models.note: Licence checked 2026-09-16 and corrected from Apache-2.0, which is a licence on code, not on these weights. WEIGHTS: the Hub card metadata says openrail on this repo, on Peng-Wang/ImageDream (the weights this repo's card says it ports into diffusers) and on MVDream/MVDream (the MVDream v2.1 weights the Peng-Wang/ImageDream card says they were fine-tuned from). None of those three repos has a licence file. https://github.com/bytedance/MVDream README.md line 26 says 'Our models are provided on the Huggingface Model Page with the OpenRAIL license.' The MVDream/MVDream card says its v2.1 model was fine-tuned from stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2-1-base, whose Hub page answered HTTP 401 on the check date. CODE: https://github.com/bytedance/ImageDream has three licence files, none about weights. LICENSE at the root is the Apache License 2.0, and README.md line 37 says the code is forked from threestudio, whose LICENSE is also the Apache License 2.0. extern/ImageDream/LICENSE-CODE, beside the diffusion model code, is the MIT License. load/lights/LICENSE.txt is CC0, for one HDR light probe. No OpenRAIL licence text was found in any of these repos, so which OpenRAIL licence applies, and whether it allows the commercial use recorded here, is unsettled.

models.name: TriplaneGaussian
models.note: Licence checked 2026-09-16 and corrected from MIT. This Hugging Face repo has no licence file, and its Hub card metadata says apache-2.0. The TriplaneGaussian code repo has three licence files: LICENSE at the root (license_url) is the Apache License 2.0, and tgs/models/pointclouds/LICENSE_POINTNET and tgs/models/snowflake/LICENSE are MIT licences under other authors' copyright, on two code modules (its README.md credits SnowflakeNet for the point cloud upsampling module). None of the three mentions the weights.

models.name: StableFast3D
models.note: Gated: accept the licence at https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-fast-3d then export HF_TOKEN
models.commercial: conditional (free under $1M annual revenue, then an Enterprise licence)

models.name: Qwen-Image Lightning 4-step LoRA
models.note: Cuts Qwen from 20 steps to 4 (cfg 1.0). Use txt2img_qwen_fast.json.

models.name: Hunyuan3D-2.1 TexGen (paint PBR)
models.commercial: conditional (excludes EU/UK/South Korea; >1M MAU needs Tencent's written licence)
models.note: Texture pass for the shape meshes. The node ignores json/yaml/py on download because the pack ships those configs.

models.name: Qwen-Image 2512 4-step (Lightning pre-merged)
models.note: Lightning baked in. Needed because applying the LoRA at runtime OOMs a 16GB card: ComfyUI dequantizes the fp8 base to patch a bf16 LoRA and the spike exceeds VRAM. A pre-merged checkpoint has nothing to patch.

models.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 (fp8)
models.note: Reuses the qwen_image text encoder and VAE from the 'qwen' group, so fetch that first or this model has nothing to run with.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo music transformer
models.note: ComfyUI's repack of ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5. The repack repo is tagged Apache-2.0; the weights are ACE-Step's MIT release. The model card states generated music may be used commercially, and that the model was trained on licensed, royalty-free and synthetic music. Used by workflows/api/txt2music_acestep15.json, split rather than the all-in-one checkpoint because only a separate text encoder loader can put the encoders on the CPU (see the planner LM's note).

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 text encoder (Qwen3 0.6B)
models.license: MIT (ACE-Step 1.5; the Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B it builds on is Apache-2.0)

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 planner LM (1.7B)
models.note: Loaded on the CPU by the graph's DualCLIPLoader. On this image's PyTorch 2.6 its sampling on the GPU produces NaN probabilities and the CUDA assert aborts the whole ComfyUI server (Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#12274, where the maintainer's answer is a newer PyTorch).

models.name: Qwen-Image-Edit Rapid AIO v19 SFW (fp8, all in one)
models.license: Apache-2.0, declared in the Hub card metadata; no licence file
models.commercial: unsettled (a merge that folds in community LoRAs: the card names some in earlier versions' notes, lists none for v19, and gives no licence for any)
models.note: Read 2026-09-30 at commit 691024f. The card says v19 merges Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 and 2511 with Lightning accelerators, and earlier versions' notes name community 'realism' LoRAs without their licences. One 28.4GB file holding the diffusion model, text encoder and VAE: load it with Load Checkpoint, 4 steps at cfg 1. Not yet run on the 31GB reference machine.

models.name: Qwen-Image-Edit Rapid AIO v18 SFW (GGUF Q4_K)
models.license: none declared on the quant; it quantises Phr00t/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO
models.commercial: unsettled (no licence on the quant, and the merge it quantises is unsettled)
models.note: v18, because v19 has no SFW GGUF. Diffusion model only: it needs the qwen group's qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled text encoder and qwen_image_vae. complete_workflow.json switches to it with its Switch Quants panel. The repo moved from Arunk25/ to Novice25/; the Hub answers the old path with a 307 (checked 2026-09-30).

models.name: WAN 2.2 I2V 14B high-noise expert (fp8)
models.note: Runs the first half of the steps; the low-noise expert runs the rest. Licence read 2026-09-30: the Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B card says 'The models in this repository are licensed under the Apache 2.0 License. We claim no rights over the your generated contents', and links a LICENSE.txt the Hub repo does not contain; the text is Apache-2.0 in the Wan-Video/Wan2.2 GitHub repo.

models.name: umT5-XXL text encoder (fp8, for WAN)
models.note: google/umt5-xxl declares apache-2.0 in its card metadata only, with no licence text. Wan also ships a umT5-XXL encoder in its own Hub repos (models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth) under the Wan card's Apache-2.0 statement. Which of the two this repackage was converted from is not stated. Read 2026-09-30.

models.name: WAN 2.1 VAE (used by WAN 2.2 14B)
models.note: The 14B experts use the 2.1 VAE, not wan2.2_vae, which belongs to the 5B model.

models.name: WAN 2.2 I2V lightx2v 4-step LoRA (high noise)
models.note: Off in complete_workflow.json. Switch on both halves together, then set both samplers to 4 steps, cfg 1, split at step 2.

models.name: Anything2Real alpha LoRA (Qwen-Image-Edit 2509)
models.license: unsettled: Apache-2.0 in the Hub card metadata, no licence file; the author's Civitai permissions for the same file allow no commercial use and no derivatives, and require credit
models.commercial: NO (treated as non-commercial until settled: the author's own Civitai permissions forbid it)
models.note: Read 2026-09-30. Civitai's API for model 2121900 returns allowCommercialUse [], allowDerivatives false, allowNoCredit false, allowDifferentLicense true; the HF card names that Civitai account (xiaozhijason) as the author's. The HF file has the same SHA-256 as Civitai version 2400325's (62ee14b0...aae9), and the Civitai download refuses an anonymous request (HTTP 401) where the HF one does not. The dest renames it to what complete_workflow.json's Image to Real group loads.

models.name: DWPose person detector (YOLOX-L, onnx)
models.note: comfyui_controlnet_aux reads its preprocessor weights from $AUX_ANNOTATOR_CKPTS_PATH/<repo>/<file>, and the image points that at /app/models/controlnet_aux so they persist across a recreate. Without this file the pack downloads it on first use, which the offline profile cannot. complete_workflow.json's Pose Transfer group runs DWPose through AIO_Preprocessor, whose defaults are these two files. The weights are Apache-2.0; the code that runs them is not: comfyui_controlnet_aux's src/custom_controlnet_aux/dwpose/ folder ships CMU's OpenPose licence, 'ACADEMIC OR NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATION NONCOMMERCIAL RESEARCH USE ONLY' (read 2026-09-30 at 0cd2904). See docs/guide/licensing.

models.name: DWPose whole-body pose estimator (TorchScript)
models.note: hr16's TorchScript export of DWPose's dw-ll_ucoco_384; the card declares apache-2.0 in metadata only, and IDEA-Research/DWPose's LICENSE is Apache-2.0. The weights are Apache-2.0; the code that runs them is not: comfyui_controlnet_aux's src/custom_controlnet_aux/dwpose/ folder ships CMU's OpenPose licence, 'ACADEMIC OR NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATION NONCOMMERCIAL RESEARCH USE ONLY' (read 2026-09-30 at 0cd2904). See docs/guide/licensing.

models.name: Krea 2 Turbo (int8 ConvRot)
models.commercial: conditional (only while company-wide revenue, affiliates included, is under $1M a year, and that covers its outputs too; Krea may end the licence on 30 days' notice; content filtering required)
models.note: The int8 build Comfy-Org's int8 templates load, for both text to image and the style reference; ComfyUI v0.30.2 loaded it and ran 8 steps at 864x1152 in 22.3 s on the 16 GB reference card (2026-10-10). Read 2026-10-10 in the LICENSE.pdf of Comfy-Org/Krea-2 at eb1eddd: 'KREA 2 Community License Agreement v.1, Date: June 22, 2026'. 2.3: Commercial Use 'of the Krea Model, Derivatives, or Outputs is permitted only if you (including all affiliated entities under common ownership or control) have total company-wide annual revenue of less than one million United States dollars ($1,000,000 USD)', and past it 'you must immediately cease Commercial Use and contact Krea'. 9.2: Krea may terminate 'for any reason upon thirty (30) days' prior written or electronic notice'. 4.2: 'You must implement reasonable and appropriate Content Filter measures'. Downloading binds you: 'BY DOWNLOADING, ACCESSING, COPYING, USING, OR DISTRIBUTING ... YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT YOU HAVE READ, UNDERSTOOD, AND AGREE'. Comfy-Org's repack is not gated; Krea's own krea/Krea-2-Turbo asks you to agree first. See docs/guide/licensing.
